output.summary: The rent of $2,550/month is below the $2,700 maximum constraint. However, the telecommunications rider explicitly states the building shared Wi-Fi is capped at 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload. This fails the primary requirement of supporting symmetrical >= 200 Mbps fiber internet for daily remote engineering needs.
key_claims: Rent is $2,550/month, which is less than the $2,700 limit.
The required internet speed is symmetrical >= 200 Mbps.
The available internet speed is capped at 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload.
risks_or_flaws: The stated internet speed (50 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up) violates the required symmetrical >= 200 Mbps internet speed.
output.verification_question: Does the 'High-speed building Wi-Fi included' statement override the explicit 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload cap detailed in the Telecommunications Rider (Clause 6.1)?
